newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic Centenary resource 2.1 mln oz gold.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic Centenary resource 2.1 mln oz gold.

text.p: Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Tuesday the resource estimate at its Centenary deposit in Western Australia has doubled to 2.1 million ounces.

Plutonic said latest drilling at the Centenary deposit, first reported last October, had lifted indicated resources to 3.5 million tonnes at 8.2 grams per tonne and inferred resources to 4.9 million tonnes at 7.4 grams per tonne.
This gave a total of 8.4 million tonnes at 7.7 grams per tonne for a total of 2.1 million contained ounces.
The probable ore reserve was put at 1.3 million tonnes at 6.8 grams per tonne for 284,000 contained ounces.
Plutonic in January reported an interim indicated resource of 3.5 million tonnes at 8.2 grams per tonne for 900,000 ounces of gold.
It said step-out diamond drilling has since continued to return exceptional results, including 135 metres at 4.4 grams per tonne of gold and 62 metres at 5.0 grams per tonne.
"Effectively two months of drilling has added another 1.2 million resource ounces," Plutonic said in a statement.
Plutonic shares were trading 10 cents stronger at A$4.70 at 1.25 p.m. (0325 GMT).
